strategy.name: intraday_sma_recentered_fixed_2000_2020
strategy.description: 把 QQQ 全历史局部高原复测后由用户确认的联合参数完整冻结，不在 SPY 上重新选参；使用 2000 年前 SPY 历史预热指标，2000-01-03 起空仓等待第一笔普通买入，在 2020-12-31 收盘停止评价。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时 OR：已有卖出价后，价格重新达到该卖出成交价（R=0%）则强制买回；价格向上穿越动态 SMA264；价格向上穿越 SMA70/80/90 三线平均值下方 0.95%。没有历史卖出价时，强制买回不可产生第一笔买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：价格低于成本价 10%；SMA70/80/90 三线平均变化率连续 3 日为负且价格跌破动态 SMA176；此前连续 4 日三线平均变化率为负且当日 SMA70、SMA80、SMA90 各自变化率全部不高于 -0.25%；价格向下穿越动态 SMA301。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完整历史，解出当日条件单阈值；2000 年前数据只用于指标预热，窗口前禁止交易。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日常规时段 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open 成交；否则常规时段调整后 OHLC 触及预先解出的理论阈值时按该阈值成交；每天最多一笔。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only；初始 100,000 美元现金，每次在全仓 SPY 与全现金之间切换，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 2000-01-03 起空仓等待第一笔普通买入；策略绩效从完整评价窗口起点计算，包含等待首买的现金期。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the 2000-01-03 regular-session Open, invest the same 100,000 USD in SPY and hold through the 2020-12-31 Close. Strategy and benchmark use identical evaluation dates; the strategy's initial cash waiting period remains part of performance.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged. The accepted zoom, visible-range Y axes, optional SMA overlays, equity selection, rebasing and DCA controls apply; keep experiment-specific annual returns and signal summaries outside the template.

research.hypothesis: The exact QQQ-selected parameter vector may retain coherent return and risk behavior on SPY during 2000–2020 without any SPY-specific optimization.
research.primary_metric: Report complete-window total return, CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, annual volatility, maximum drawdown, drawdown duration, exposure and order counts against identical-window SPY Buy & Hold; do not optimize or rank parameters.
research.selection_rule: None. The complete parameter vector was frozen by the user before this SPY run and exactly one zero-cost case is evaluated.
research.validation_plan: The fixed SPY case must match PyBroker and the independent pandas ledger on daily cash, shares, equity, order dates, sides, shares, fills and trade accounting; the first order must be an ordinary buy, pre-2000 rows may only warm indicators, and daily trades cannot exceed one.
research.promotion_criteria: No automatic promotion. SPY is economically related to QQQ and this is a retrospective zero-cost test, so even favorable results only provide cross-asset historical context.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if any frozen parameter changes, any pre-window row trades, the first order is seeded or forced re-entry, daily orders exceed one, Buy & Hold uses another window, data is unapproved, or PyBroker and the independent ledger diverge.
